propositions: Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) lack a truthful administrative exit path today; only bugs can close via duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated, forcing operators to use --force for legitimately obsolete or wontfix work.

Three new administrative disposition classes (obsolete, superseded, wontfix) must be added to the single-sourced CLOSE_CLASSES vocabulary and persisted across schemas and type definitions with drift-guard tests.

obsolete/wontfix closes require a reason (persisted as close_reason distinct from force_close_reason); --reason flag must be reused and admitted without --force for these classes; the reason must be threaded through CLI->transition_compute->transition_core and folded into reduced ticket state.

Reason-only administrative closes (obsolete/wontfix) must skip completion verification checks and return a signed disposition attestation; replacement-bearing classes (duplicate, superseded) must demand a live replacement link via _ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked.

The close_precheck refusal message must enumerate the applicable --class values for each ticket type to surface the truthful administrative exit and eliminate the deceptive 'complete the work' guidance for non-completion closes.

Write-side enforcement in txn.transition_core must gate non-bug closes to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES only and reject not_a_bug/escalated (bug-only vocabulary), blocking this refusal bypass with --force or a disabled gate.
